jobs.description:
Together we fight for everyone’s opportunity for a better financial future.

We will do this together — with customers, partners and colleagues. We will fight for others, not against: We will stand up for and champion everyone’s access to opportunities. The status quo is not good enough … we believe every individual and every community deserves access to financial opportunities. We are determined to support both individuals and communities in reaching a better financial future.  We know that reaching this future depends on our actions today.

Like our Purpose Statement, Voya believes in being bold and committed to action.  We are committed to a work environment where the differences that we are born with — and those we acquire throughout our lives — are understood, valued and intentionally pursued. We believe that our employees own our culture and have a responsibility to foster an environment where we all feel comfortable bringing our whole selves to work. Purposefully bringing our differences together to positively influence our culture, serve our clients and enrich our communities is essential to our vision.

Are you ready to join a company with a strong purpose and a winning culture? Start your Voyage – Apply Now

Get to Know the Opportunity:
As a Senior Program Manager, you will serve as the primary point of accountability for planning and delivering large, complex projects or medium-to-large programs that support business unit and enterprise priorities. You will lead initiatives that span multiple business and technology areas, involve significant organizational change, and typically manage budgets of $8M-$15M, with programs up to $15M. Working with a high degree of autonomy, you will bring structure, transparency, and disciplined execution to changing scope, complex dependencies, and elevated delivery risk. You will also help strengthen Voya's delivery methodologies, standards, tools, and project management community.

The Contributions You’ll Make:
- Own end-to-end planning, execution, implementation readiness, and reporting for complex projects and programs across multiple business and technology areas.

- Translate business problems and expected benefits into clear program objectives, measurable outcomes, delivery plans, and decision points.

- Deliver agreed outcomes on time, within scope and budget, and to established quality standards while balancing stakeholder expectations and acceptable risk.

- Develop and maintain an integrated view of milestones, dependencies, resources, risks, issues, assumptions, and impacts across projects, programs, and portfolios.

- Create early visibility into critical risks and dependencies, drive practical mitigation plans, and escalate decisions before delivery, budget, readiness, or acceptance is jeopardized.

- Remove barriers, resolve competing priorities, and enable cross-functional teams to maintain momentum through complex execution challenges.

- Partner with Finance to manage forecasts, understand cost drivers, explain financial performance, and provide leadership with actionable insight.

- Build trusted relationships with sponsors and senior leaders; communicate concise recommendations, trade-offs, and decisions with confidence and transparency.

- Influence business strategy and shape initiatives by connecting delivery choices to customer value, enterprise priorities, and expected benefits.

- Lead organizational readiness and change efforts so stakeholders understand the purpose, impact, and actions required for adoption.

- Manage vendor relationships and third-party commitments when required, including delivery expectations, dependencies, risks, and performance.

- Capture lessons learned, retain reusable knowledge, and identify opportunities to simplify delivery, reduce cost, and improve efficiency.

- Coach and mentor members of the project management community and model consistent use of Voya delivery methodologies, standards, and tools.

Minimum Knowledge & Experience:

- 5+ years of experience leading large or significant projects or medium-to-large programs, typically with budgets of $8M-$15M.

- Expert knowledge of project, program, or portfolio management principles, governance, controls, tools, and delivery practices.

- Demonstrated success leading complex initiatives through highly matrixed, cross-functional teams across business and technology organizations.

- Strong financial acumen, including experience with budgets, forecasts, cost drivers, trade-offs, and outcome-based investment decisions.

- Proven ability to identify what is critical, simplify complex problems, set priorities, and drive timely, well-reasoned decisions.

- Experience proactively managing dependencies, risks, issues, organizational readiness, and stakeholder acceptance in dynamic environments.

- Ability to influence and inspire without direct authority, build partnerships across organizational levels, and establish credibility with senior leaders.

- Clear, concise, and audience-appropriate verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.

- Sound judgment, self-awareness, resilience, and the ability to remain effective under pressure while managing tight deadlines and acceptable risk.

- Ability to work with a high degree of autonomy while remaining disciplined, flexible, collaborative, and accountable for outcomes.

- Bachelor's degree in business, technology, project management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience.

Preferred Knowledge & Experience:
- Experience in financial services or management consulting, particularly within retirement or employee benefits.  Experience leading business transformation, technology modernization, or enterprise change initiatives across multiple functions.

- Experience providing oversight for a business or technology portfolio and managing complex vendor relationships.

- Project or program management certification, such as PMP, PgMP, or an equivalent industry-recognized credential.

- Master's degree in business, technology, project management, or a related field.

Voya Investment Management (IM) is seeking an SVP, Client Portfolio Manager to support IM’s Fixed Income team.  As a member of the Fixed Income Client Portfolio Manager Team, this role is responsible for presenting and working with external clients as a representative of Voya’s Fixed Income Platform.  The SVP, Client Portfolio Manager will engage with Intermediaries (Retail) and Institutional Clients, with an emphasis on the In stitutional   channel.  In addition, the SVP, Client Portf olio Manager will contribute to   fixed income platform materials, thought leadership and client communications used with internal and external partners. This position will be located in the Atlanta office.

Key Responsibilities

- Perform as a senior advocate and representative of IM's Fixed Income investment platform among internal stakeholders, institutional investors, consultants, and external clients, with approximately 40-60% travel required.

- Serve as a senior client-facing representative of the Fixed Income platform, presenting investment capabilities to institutional and intermediary clients, conducting portfolio reviews, participating in prospect meetings, supporting business development efforts, and helping drive asset growth opportunities.

- Conduct market research and uncovering and sharing insights regarding the competitive landscape.

- Serve as a technical investment expert alongside sales professionals, helping articulate investment strategies, differentiate Voya's capabilities, and influence institutional investment decision-makers

- Respond to internal and external client inquiries.

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Finance or related field with 15 years minimum of financial services experience, preferably in asset management or capital markets. Minimum 7-10 years public or private Fixed Income experience required.  MBA and/or CFA preferred.

- Experience as a Client Portfolio Manager, Investment Specialist, Institutional Consultant, Manager Research Professional, or similar client-facing investment role within asset management, consulting, or capital markets environments.

- Passion for investments, fixed income markets, and client engagement, with a demonstrated ability to communicate investment insights, influence decision-makers, and deliver solutions to sophisticated institutional investors.

- Strong executive presence, credibility, and presentation skills with the ability to effectively engage institutional investors, investment consultants, and senior investment professionals.

- Strong interpersonal skills with ability to engage with many individuals throughout the organization.

- Ability to multi-task and work in a high-paced, team-oriented environment.

About the Role
Voya is building a next-generation, AI-native Wealth Management platform designed to serve as the digital front door for the enterprise. This platform will create a unified client experience across Retirement, Employee Benefits, Wealth Management, and Investment Management, enabling clients to seamlessly discover, engage, and transact across Voya's full suite of solutions.
The Director, Engineering (Business Strategy, Platform Roadmap & Client Experience) serves as the critical bridge between business strategy, product management, customer experience, and engineering execution. This leader translates enterprise priorities into technology roadmaps and ensures delivery of a scalable platform that connects participants, plan sponsors, advisors, employers, and individual investors through a single, integrated ecosystem.
This role is ideal for a technology leader who understands both business growth objectives and modern digital platform architectures. The successful candidate will help shape the future of Voya's digital experience by creating technology capabilities that drive client acquisition, retention, cross-sell expansion, and long-term relationship growth.
What You'll Do
Own the Business-to-Technology Roadmap
- Develop and maintain a multi-year technology roadmap aligned with Voya's strategic growth priorities across Retirement, Wealth Management, Employee Benefits, and Investment Management.
- Translate executive business objectives into actionable technology initiatives, investment plans, and engineering priorities.
- Partner with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and business leaders to define sequencing, dependencies, and outcomes.
- Ensure technology investments are prioritized based on business value, client impact, enterprise scalability, and regulatory requirements.

Lead the "One Front Door" Strategy
- Drive development of a unified digital experience serving both B2B and B2C client segments.
- Define capabilities that create a seamless experience across: - Retirement participants
- Plan sponsors
- Advisors
- Employers
- Individual investors
- Wealth Management clients

- Partner across business areas to eliminate client friction and create connected customer journeys.
- Ensure clients can easily discover, access, and engage with relevant Voya products and services through a common platform experience.

Connect Enterprise Businesses Through Technology
- Build alignment across Retirement, Employee Benefits, Investment Management, and Wealth Management teams.
- Identify opportunities to leverage shared digital capabilities, customer data, AI solutions, and platform services.
- Champion enterprise-wide thinking instead of line-of-business optimization.
- Drive platform strategies that increase customer lifetime value and improve client retention.

Drive AI-Native Digital Transformation
- Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to embed AI-driven experiences across the client lifecycle.
- Identify opportunities for: - Intelligent recommendations
- Personalized financial guidance
- Conversational experiences
- Digital onboarding
- Cross-sell and next-best-action capabilities

- Ensure AI investments remain aligned with business outcomes and customer needs.
- Drive adoption of modern digital, cloud, data, and AI capabilities across the platform.

Deliver Business Outcomes
- Define success metrics tied to client adoption, engagement, retention, cross-sell growth, digital utilization, and advisor productivity.
- Establish governance mechanisms to monitor roadmap progress and business value realization.
- Lead executive-level communications regarding priorities, progress, risks, and investment decisions.
- Drive decision-making across highly matrixed stakeholder groups.

Stakeholder Leadership
- Serve as the primary liaison between business executives and technology teams.
- Facilitate prioritization discussions among competing business units and stakeholder groups.
- Build consensus around strategic technology decisions.
- Present roadmap recommendations and investment cases to senior leadership.

Qualifications
Required Experience
- 10+ years of progressive experience spanning technology, product, strategy, digital transformation, or engineering leadership.
- Experience leading large-scale digital platform or customer experience initiatives.
- Experience operating within highly regulated industries, preferably financial services, retirement, wealth management, insurance, or investment management.
- Proven ability to translate business strategy into technology execution.
- Demonstrated success leading complex cross-functional programs with multiple stakeholders.

Preferred Experience
- Experience supporting Wealth Management, Retirement Services, Employee Benefits, Investment Management, or FinTech platforms.
- Experience building platform-based ecosystems serving multiple customer segments.
- Knowledge of advisor technology, participant experience platforms, client onboarding, customer portals, or wealth management solutions.
- Experience leveraging AI, analytics, and automation to improve customer outcomes.
- Familiarity with cloud-native digital platforms, APIs, data ecosystems, and modern engineering delivery models.

Leadership Competencies
- Enterprise mindset with strong business acumen
- Strategic thinker with exceptional execution discipline
- Influential leader capable of aligning diverse stakeholders
- Strong communicator across executive, business, and technical audiences
- Data-driven decision maker
- Client-centric and growth-oriented
- Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving transformation

Success Measures
Within the first 12–24 months, this leader will:
- Establish and execute the enterprise roadmap for the AI-native digital platform.
- Deliver measurable progress toward the "one front door" client experience strategy.
- Improve cross-business client engagement and product adoption.
- Increase integration across Retirement, Employee Benefits, Wealth Management, and Investment Management offerings.
- Accelerate delivery of scalable digital capabilities that drive client growth, retention, and long-term value creation.
- Build strong alignment between business strategy and engineering execution.

- Demonstrated senior program management experience, including strategic planning, integrated roadmap development, governance routines, executive-level status reporting,   financial management , risk and issue management, and dependency coordination.

- Proven ability to partner with senior business and technology leaders to translate enterprise   objectives   into actionable plans, measurable outcomes, and disciplined delivery execution.

In this role, you will partner with the Regional Manager in executing on a marketing plan to find and cultivate the sources of core and core-plus loans, to include the initial underwriting, credit analysis, and investment committee presentations of new investment opportunities.

The Contributions You'll Make
Mortgage Loan Origination Responsibilities
- Solicit mortgage loans through correspondent mortgage bankers and brokers in defined geographic territory.
- Member of a team that directly solicits mortgage loans from large national accounts.
- Review and underwrite proposed mortgage loans.
- Negotiate and structure mortgage loan investments.
- Underwrite, value, and inspect the security in collaboration with analysts and team leads.
- Prepare detailed analysis and presentation of mortgage loan investments to the investment committee.
- Negotiate and issue mortgage loan term sheets.
- Coordinate, with legal counsel, the closing of mortgage loan transactions and negotiation of loan documents.

General Responsibilities
- Produce the required volume of quality mortgage loan transactions at required yields.
- Research new territories where required and continually review existing territories in search of quality mortgage loan transactions.
- Contribute value added knowledge of local real estate markets within territory.
- Build and maintain relationships with correspondent mortgage bankers, mortgage brokers, and borrowers.
- Maintain general knowledge of factors affecting the real estate market and economy.
- Provide leadership in areas of program and subordinate development.

Minimum Knowledge & Experience
- Bachelor’s degree required, MBA preferred.
- Minimum of 10 years’ work experience in commercial real estate required.
- Ability to evaluate real estate and real estate markets.
- Detailed knowledge of mortgage loan documentation, analysis, and legal issues.
- Knowledge of alternative investments and relative value.
- Management and leadership skills are necessary to implement directives and obtain established goals.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills.
- Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills.

Additional Information
This role will be based in our Atlanta, GA office and will be a hybrid work schedule. Frequent travel to assigned territory to inspect assets, build and strengthen correspondent relationships and develop knowledge of the local markets within the territory is required.

- Experience building and maintaining professional relationships with brokers, consultants, TPAs, carriers, vendors, or employer groups
